# Pedrali

> > Italian furniture manufacturer specializing in Made in Italy design furniture for contract, hospitality, workspaces, outdoor, and residential environments.

Pedrali collaborates with renowned designers including Robin Rizzini, Busetti Garuti Redaelli, Cazzaniga Mandelli Pagliarulo, and Patrick Jouin to create contemporary furniture collections. The company focuses on contract industry solutions while also serving residential markets with collections like Rizz, Buddy Oasi, Nemea, and Ester Lounge.
